{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year=2019–20 |team=Saint Mary's Gaels |sport=Basketball |image=Saint Mary's College Gaels logo.svg |image_size=200px |conference=West Coast Conference |short_conf=WCC |record=26–8 |conf_record=11–5 |CoachRank= |APRank= |head_coach=[[Randy Bennett]] |hc_year = 19th |asst_coach1=Marcus Schroeder |asst_coach2=[[Justin Joyner]] |asst_coach3=[[Mickey McConnell]] |stadium=[[University Credit Union Pavilion]] |champion = |tourney= |tourney_result= }} {{2019–20 West Coast Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2019–20 Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team''' represented [[Saint Mary's College of California]] during the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by head coach [[Randy Bennett]] in his 19th season at Saint Mary's. The Gaels played their home games at the [[University Credit Union Pavilion]] in [[Moraga, California]] as members of the [[West Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 26–8, 11–5 in WCC play to finish in a tie for third place. They defeated [[2019–20 Pepperdine Waves men's basketball team|Pepperdine]] and [[2019–20 BYU Cougars men's basketball team|BYU]] to advance to the championship game of the [[2020 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]] where they lost to [[2019–20 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]]. Despite being a virtual lock to receive an at-large bid to [[2020 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], all postseason play was cancelled amid the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]]. ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team|Gaels]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 22–12, 11–5 in West Coast Conference play to finish in second place. As the No. 2 seed in the [[2019 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]], they defeated [[2018–19 Pepperdine Waves men's basketball team|Pepperdine]] in the semifinals and upset No. 1 seed [[2018–19 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]] to become champions of the WCC Tournament. As a result, they received an automatic bid to the [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as a No. 11 where they lost to [[2018–19 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Villanova]] in the first round.{{Cite web|url=https://athlonsports.com/college-basketball/saint-marys-basketball-gaels-team-preview-and-season-prediction-2019-20|title=Saint Mary's Basketball: Gaels Team Preview and Season Prediction 2019-20|date=2019-09-23|website=AthlonSports.com|language=en|access-date=2019-11-08}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
